label: Paired Akan conceptual decolonization with postcolonial feminist cultural critique
description: Alongside Wiredu’s call for conceptual decolonization in Ghana, Aidoo used literary-philosophical satire to expose Western epistemic arrogance and elite cultural alienation.
dialecticalTension: Unites Akan philosophical self-recovery with anti-colonial feminist voice.

label: Pioneered African women’s critique of colonial education and cultural alienation
description: Aidoo’s exploration of African women’s autonomy and colonial mimicry helped clear the intellectual horizon for Dangarembga’s Nervous Conditions.
